== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Shawn Valdez (Japanese)|Shawn Valdez]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156433107/_Z-eT8RAn06wZaXU6RSZLA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89232345.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>1f3f86f4210084b4ab696893fe0824b9497b51c1e162353ed98062625f99afb6</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
